name: koosys-cc
description: KooSys CC: checks C files against the KooSys MISRA list and KooSys coding guidelines on save. Fully offline; all engines are built in.

koosys.runOnSave.description: Check .c/.h files when they are saved.

koosys.includePaths.description: Extra include directories (added to the automatically found ones). ${workspaceFolder} is expanded.

koosys.defines.description: Preprocessor defines (-D), e.g. "CPU_FREQ=8000000". Needed only when a header stops with #error without them.

koosys.disabledRules.description: Rule ids not to report, e.g. ["15.5", "KSYS-FUNC-02"].

koosys.wholeProgramRules.description: Rules that need the whole program; hidden in single-file checks because they are wrong there (e.g. 8.7 flags every public function).

koosys.ruleTextsFile.description: Optional CSV (rule,text) with the guideline text shown in hovers. Not bundled: the text belongs to the company document.

koosys.formatting.description: Report layout rules (tabs, line length, LF endings, 4-space indent) as Info.

koosys.maxFunctionLines.description: KSYS-FUNC-01: maximum function body length in lines ("one page").

koosys.minAssertions.description: KSYS-FUNC-02: minimum assertions per function (0 disables).

koosys.assertionMacros.description: Calls counted as assertions for KSYS-FUNC-02.

koosys.requirementIdPattern.description: KSYS-DOC-02: regular expression a function's doxygen comment must contain (e.g. "SWRS-[A-Z]+-\\d+"). Empty = not checked.

koosys.moduleAbbreviation.description: KSYS-NAME-03: required global-variable prefix for this project (without the underscore). Empty = any lowercase prefix.

koosys.checkDosFileNames.description: KSYS-FILE-02: check DOS 8.3 file names (off: contradicts KooSys 4.1's own example module_name.c).

koosys.autoIncludePaths.description: Use every workspace folder that contains a header as an include path (no configuration needed).

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/engines.test.js out/test/textchecks.test.js
scripts.package: npm run bundle-rules && npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license
scripts.package:target: npm run bundle-rules && npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --target
